history.summary: A 1,066 sqft 3BR at Tropical Spring, a 99LH Simei (D18) condo built 2003, just 400m from EW3 Simei MRT, at $1.45M / $1,360 psf. Strong realized appreciation (6.7%/yr over a solid 46-txn series) and excellent MRT proximity are offset by an aging 99LH (~22 years gone) and an asking PSF ~8% above the $1,263 median.
history.rating_rationale: The 6.7%/yr CAGR on 46 transactions is genuinely strong for OCR D18 and 400m-to-MRT is a real liquidity/rental anchor near Tampines Regional Centre and Changi Business Park. But the 99LH is now ~22 years old (lease decay accelerates from here on a 5–7yr hold), and $1,360 psf is an ~8% premium to the median — paying up for a lease that's running down. The catalysts (CRL Tampines, mature estate) support a hold but the entry is full.
red_flags: 99LH built 2003 — ~22 years elapsed, lease decay a growing headwind
Older development — higher maintenance, dated facilities vs new launches
catalysts: 400m to Simei MRT — strong rental/exit liquidity
Proximity to Changi Business Park, SUTD, Tampines Regional Centre + CRL
Documented 6.7%/yr appreciation on a credible 46-txn series
